dbqueries.dbquery:
SELECT CASE WHEN tp.position_type_ext_int = ? THEN 'External' WHEN tp.position_type_ext_int = ? THEN 'Internal' END AS fld10,tp.position_id,
(SELECT td.dept_name FROM tp_departments td WHERE tp.sub_dept_id=td.dept_id) AS fld8, CONCAT(tu1.user_fname, ' ', tu1.user_lname) AS fld11, CAST((GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tl.location_name SEPARATOR ', ')) as CHAR) AS fld14, band_name as fld13, grade_name as fld12, tp.position_code as fld9, tp.position_title as fld0, date_format(tp.position_date_created,'%d-%b-%y') as fld17, (SELECT CONCAT(tu2.user_fname, ' ', tu2.user_lname) FROM tp_users tu2 WHERE tu2.user_id = tp.position_created_by) AS fld16, tp.position_no_of_openings as fld2, tp.position_priority, CASE WHEN tp.position_status = ? THEN 'Deleted' WHEN tp.position_status = ? THEN 'Opened' WHEN tp.position_status = ? THEN 'Closed' WHEN tp.position_status = ? THEN 'In Process' WHEN tp.position_status = ? THEN 'Rejected' WHEN tp.position_status = ? THEN 'Hold' WHEN tp.position_status = ? THEN 'Template' WHEN tp.position_status = ? THEN 'To be Opened' WHEN tp.position_status = ? THEN 'Approval Pending' END as fld15 , tp.position_type_ext_int,
(SELECT count(*) FROM tp_applicants ta , tp_position_steps tps WHERE ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id AND ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id AND (tps.position_step_level=? OR tps.position_step_level=?)) AS fld3,
(SELECT count(*) FROM tp_applicants ta , tp_position_steps tps WHERE ta.applicant_position_id=tp.position_id AND ta.applicant_step_id=tps.position_step_id AND tps.position_step_level=?) AS fld4,
(SELECT count(*) FROM tp_applicant_joining_history ta WHERE ta.position_id=tp.position_id) AS fld5,
(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM tp_applicant_selection_process WHERE position_step_id_to IN (?,?,?,?)) AS tasp WHERE tasp.position_id=tp.position_id) AS fld6, td.dept_name as fld1, date_format(tp.position_date_expiry,'%d-%b-%y') as fld7, is_budget_committed,
(SELECT td2.dept_name FROM tp_departments td2 WHERE tp.sub_sub_dept_id=td2.dept_id) AS fld16, (SELECT td3.dept_name FROM tp_departments td3 WHERE tp.sub3_dept_id=td3.dept_id) AS fld17, (SELECT td4.dept_name FROM tp_departments td4 WHERE tp.sub4_dept_id=td4.dept_id) AS fld18, (SELECT CONCAT(tu7.user_fname, ' ', tu7.user_lname) FROM tp_users tu7 WHERE tu7.user_id = tp.position_requested_by) AS fld20, date_format(tp.position_date_created,'%d %b %Y') AS fld19, CASE WHEN tp.type_of_vacancy = ? THEN NULL WHEN tp.type_of_vacancy = ? THEN tp.replacement_emp_code END AS fld21, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tsk.skill SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_position_skills tpsk LEFT JOIN tp_skills tsk ON (tpsk.skill_id = tsk.skill_id) WHERE tpsk.position_id = tp.position_id AND tpsk.skill_type = ? ) AS fld22, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tsk.skill SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_position_skills tpsk LEFT JOIN tp_skills tsk ON (tpsk.skill_id = tsk.skill_id) WHERE tpsk.position_id = tp.position_id AND tpsk.skill_type = ? ) AS fld23, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tdgr.degree_title SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_degrees tdgr,tp_position_degrees tpd WHERE tpd.degree_id = tdgr.degree_id AND tpd.position_id=tp.position_id) AS fld24, CONCAT(tp.position_min_exp, CONCAT(CONCAT(' to ',tp.position_max_exp)),' years') AS fld25, date_format(tp.position_date_closed,'%d %b %Y') as fld36, tp.type_of_vacancy as fld26, CASE WHEN tp.position_closed_by = '-1' THEN tp.position_closed_by ELSE (SELECT CONCAT(tu8.user_fname, ' ', tu8.user_lname) FROM tp_users tu8 WHERE tu8.user_id = tp.position_closed_by) END AS fld27, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ta1.applicant_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM tp_applicant_joining_history ta, tp_applicants ta1 WHERE ta.position_id=tp.position_id AND ta1.applicant_id=ta.applicant_id) AS fld28, (SELECT count(*) FROM tp_position_documents tpd WHERE tpd.position_id=tp.position_id) AS fld29
FROM tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_custom_field_values_position tvp ON (tp.position_id=tvp.entity_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tpl.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_location_ap tl ON (tpl.location_id = tl.location_id) LEFT JOIN tp_users tu1 ON (tu1.user_id = tp.position_owner_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_bands tbb ON (tp.band_id = tbb.band_id) LEFT JOIN tp_budget_grades tbg ON tp.grade_id = tbg.grade_id LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON tp.dept_id=td.dept_id WHERE tp.position_id in (@@) GROUP BY tp.position_id ORDER BY tp.position_priority, tp.position_title
